description: ROS 2 graph only; on a DDS-only setup use `list_participants`. Describe one ROS 2 node as a `NodeInfo`: the topics it publishes and subscribes to, the services and actions it serves or calls (each `{name, type}`), its parameters and `use_sim_time`. Interfaces come from the graph (`ros2 node info`), which never waits for the node. Parameters come from a read (`ros2 param dump`) bounded by `timeout_s`: **a node that does not answer in time is a finding, not an error**: `parameters` is `null`, `parameters_note` says its executor is probably blocked, and the interfaces are still returned. A value whose name contains password, secret, token, api_key or credential is replaced by `<masked>` and a long value is cut (`truncated`, `original_size`), both said in `parameters_note`. With several nodes of that name `duplicate_count` is above 1 and `note` warns. **Raises an MCP error** when the node is not on the graph (the message lists close matches), the name is malformed, or without a `ros2` CLI. **Read-only**: the only request TopicForge ever sends is a parameter read (list/get); it sends no other request to a node. **Duration**: `ros2` CLI behind the ROS lock, one call at a time; up to three CLI calls (node list and info, 8 s each at most; the parameter read, at most `timeout_s`, 20 s); ends within 45 s, less time for the read after a wait; `busy` error if the lock is held (retry).

node.description: Fully qualified node name as `list_nodes` gives it, e.g. `/robot1/lidar_driver` (a missing leading `/` is added).

timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the parameter read, 1..20, default 8. A node that does not answer is reported in `parameters_note`, not as an error.

name: get_node_info

name.description: Fully qualified topic, service or action name.

masked.description: True when the name looks like a secret (password, secret, token, api_key, credential) and the value is `<masked>`.

original_size.description: Characters (string) or elements (list) the value had before the cut. `None` unless `truncated` is true.

truncated.description: True when `value` was cut because it was too long (an URDF, a long list).

value.description: Boolean, integer, float, string or a list of those; `<masked>` when masked; the first elements when cut.

outputSchema.description: Detail of one node: its interfaces, its parameters and `use_sim_time`.

duplicate_count.description: Nodes using this exact full name; above 1, the data above belongs to one of them.

parameters.description: Parameters sorted by name; `None` when unreadable (see `parameters_note`); an empty list means none.

parameters_note.description: Why `parameters` is `None`, or what was masked or cut; `None` when complete.

service_servers.description: Services the node offers, its own parameter services included.

use_sim_time.description: Value of the node's `use_sim_time` parameter. `None` when unknown: see `use_sim_time_note`.

use_sim_time_note.description: Why `use_sim_time` is `None`. `None` when it is set.

outputSchema.title: NodeInfo
